models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.about: The most careful in our tests: it opens the passage before it cites it. Best choice for 48 GB or more.

models.name: Qwen3.5 35B-A3B
models.about: As accurate as the largest in our tests. It often cites from a search result without opening the passage, which the app points out. For 32 GB or more.

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.about: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning model. Opens the passage before it cites it. For 24 GB or more.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.about: Small. It searches and cites every time, but got about two in three of our test questions right, and says it can't find things that are there: check each answer against the paragraph it cites.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
models.about: The smallest, for 8 GB computers. Quick, but it got about two in three of our test questions right and sometimes gives a figure from memory: check every figure against the paragraph it cites.
